equation_reviews.reason: E.3 requires i=-(1/R)dv/dx; differentiate E.5 and use gamma^2=RG.
The boundary-value solution gives G/gamma. Units also require conductance, whereas gamma/G has resistance units.
Reciprocal of corrected E.8; consistent with the differential equations and boundary conditions.
Substitute R=R_S/W_M and G=1/(W R_Si) into gamma=sqrt(RG).

For x=gamma W, exact total resistance is R_Si x coth(x), while exact added metal resistance is R_Si[x coth(x)-1]. The approximation adds R_Si x^2/3. Relative errors in the total and added metal resistance differ materially; do not reuse the source accuracy percentages as independently verified metal-only accuracy.

derivation.assumptions: Positive uniform per-length R and G; source Appendix E linear distributed ladder and its boundary conditions.

dac_kTC_review.claim: For a single ideal linear capacitor equilibrated at T in the classical regime, Var(v)=k_B T/C follows from equipartition of fluctuating voltage energy. Ideal isolation preserves the sampled variance.
dac_kTC_review.provenance: Correctly labeled independent derivation and explicit supplied-corpus gap; not attributed to DAC paper.
dac_kTC_review.assumptions: Thermal equilibrium, classical regime, one independent capacitor degree of freedom, ideal linear capacitor, ideal isolation. Actual converter topology, finite settling, correlation, and added switch effects require a complete noise model.
dac_kTC_review.optional_wording: Thermal noise constrains effective sampling capacitance, and hence unit capacitance after topology and the noise allocation are fixed.
